title: MEIKO — Happy Anniversary! 2024〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Sounds good. I think I'll go with the drums for today's practice with everyone.
se_run_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hm? Someone's running this way...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
There you are!
This might be a little sudden, MEIKO, but is there anything you'd like to do?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Huh? Anything I'd like to do?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hold on, are you preparing for my anniversary?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! H-How did you know?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyone who can read between the lines would know from the way you asked.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: B-But, but...! It's still a month away! I didn't think she would see through me!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I guess you were a little too direct.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Noooo...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hmm... Should I have pretended I didn't notice anything?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's okay, please don't mind her. I mean, that was a little...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, Saki's just being a klutz.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: A k-klutz?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm just telling the truth.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ack!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Sob*
Honaaa. My heart is broken in pieces...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: There, there. You were just a little too enthusiastic about celebrating.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Haha. I will say, I'm touched that you want to start preparing a month early.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We'll need to prepare in between practices, so we thought we should at least decide what we're doing as soon as possible.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
So, to rewind the conversation...
Is there anything you want to do?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hmm... Is there anything...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Sorry.
I don't really have anything that I definitely want to do...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Anything is okay, MEIKO! A takoyaki party or even hot pot, you name it! There's so many fun things we can do!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Right...
Doing something with everyone does sound fun.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: MEIKO, is there really nothing you want to do?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Or could it be that it'd be hard for us to make it happen...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's not it at all. I really can't think of anything in particular...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: If I had to say something, it would be a performance... But we already do that together basically every day.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: As far as something special or befitting of my anniversary, nothing comes to mind.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm sorry I can't give you a proper answer.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Now that I think about it... Maybe the reason why nothing comes to mind is because I'm content with how things are now.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: How things are now...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yeah. Like I mentioned before, we basically perform together every day, don't we?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I have so much fun that I don't need anything else.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Since I'm already satisfied with just that, I think it's hard for me to come up with other ideas.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's why I'll be more than happy If I can just do something fun with all of you like Saki suggested before.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: MEIKO...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I didn't realize you enjoyed performing with us that much.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I do. I mean, just a moment ago, I was figuring out which instrument to go with for today's practice.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So if I can just do something with all of you...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, I've got it!
I can just do that together with you girls!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? Do what?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Did you come up with something?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I did!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, what I want to do is...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Prepare my anniversary party with all of you!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, I se—Whaaaaaaat?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're going to prepare for your own anniversary?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Well, everyone would usually tell me that I don't need to do anything and I should just look forward to it...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But I thought it might actually be interesting to plan and execute my own anniversary celebration!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. That really sounds like you, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I know, right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, I hope you'll all lend me a hand!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Of course. If that's what you want, then we'll help out however we can.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Mhm♪ The MEIKO in our world is also going to hold a massive event, so we need to make sure our party tops that!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I get how you feel, but isn't that a pretty big goal to set?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Who cares♪ It's all about the intention behind it!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: By the way, what sort of event is the me in your world doing?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Would you like to see the event's website? The details have been trickling in recently.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Really? Let's see it.
